parameters.name: InstanceIdList
parameters.description: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query. Specify the value in the `["<Instance ID 1>","<Instance ID 2>",……]` format.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The mitigation plan type of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

- **0**: Professional.
- **1**: Enterprise.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeList
parameters.description: The mitigation plan types of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the protection target for the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The protocol type of the IP assets protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

- **IPv4**: IPv4 protocol.
- **IPv6**: IPv6 protocol.

parameters.name: Orderby
parameters.description:
The field used to sort the Anti-DDoS Origin instance list. The value is fixed as **expireTime**, which indicates that instances are sorted by expiration time.

You can use the **Orderdire** parameter to specify the sort order.

parameters.name: Orderdire
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **desc** (default): descending order by expiration time.
- **asc**: ascending order by expiration time.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paged query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of instances to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

> You can call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.
